title.raw: 卷十九 本紀第十九 徽宗一 Volume 19 Annals 19: Huizong 1

sentences.zh: 元符三年正月己卯，哲宗崩，皇太后垂簾，哭謂宰臣曰：「國家不幸，大行皇帝無子，天下事須早定。

translations.literal: Third year of Yuanfu, first month, day jimao: Zhezong died. The Empress Dowager held the curtain and wept, telling the chief ministers: "The state has met misfortune. The late emperor had no son. The affairs of the empire must be settled soon.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 3, first month, jimao: Zhezong died. Empress Dowager Xiang drew the curtain and wept before the chief ministers: "Misfortune has struck the realm. The late emperor left no son. The throne must be settled at once.

sentences.zh: 」章惇又曰：「在禮律當立母弟簡王。

translations.literal: " Zhang Dun again said: "By ritual law the one to be enthroned should be the younger uterine brother, Prince Jian."
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Dun spoke again: "Ritual law demands the younger uterine brother—Prince Jian."

sentences.zh: 」皇太后曰：「神宗諸子，申王長而有目疾，次則端王當立。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager said: "Among Shenzong's sons, Prince Shen is eldest but has an eye ailment; next Prince Duan should be enthroned."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said: "Of Shenzong's sons, Prince Shen is eldest but blind in one eye; next in order stands Prince Duan."

sentences.zh: 」惇厲聲對曰：「以年則申王長，以禮律則同母之弟簡王當立。

translations.literal: Dun answered sharply: "By age Prince Shen is eldest; by ritual law the uterine younger brother Prince Jian should be enthroned."
translations.idiomatic: Dun answered in a harsh voice: "By years Shen is eldest; by law the uterine brother Jian is heir."

sentences.zh: 」皇太后曰：「皆神宗子，莫難如此分別，于次端王當立。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager said: "All are Shenzong's sons—must it be so hard to distinguish? Next in order Prince Duan should be enthroned."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said: "They are all Shenzong's sons—why split hairs? Next stands Prince Duan."

sentences.zh: 」知樞密院曾布曰：「章惇未嘗與臣等商議，如皇太后聖諭極當。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zeng Bu said: "Zhang Dun never consulted with us ministers; the Empress Dowager's sacred instruction is utterly appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu, Vice Director of Military Affairs, said: "Zhang Dun never took counsel with us; the Empress Dowager's word is wholly right."

sentences.zh: 」尚書左丞蔡卞、中書門下侍郎許將相繼曰：「合依聖旨。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Cai Bian and Gate Vice Director Xu Jiang said in succession: "We should follow the sacred edict."
translations.idiomatic: Cai Bian and Xu Jiang, in turn: "Let it follow the sacred edict."

sentences.zh: 」皇太后又曰：「先帝嘗言，端王有福壽，且仁孝，不同諸王。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager again said: "The late emperor once said Prince Duan has fortune and long life, and is humane and filial, unlike the other princes."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager added: "The late emperor said Duan was blessed with fortune and years, humane and filial—unlike his brothers."

sentences.zh: 」於是惇為之默然。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dun fell silent.
translations.idiomatic: At that Dun said no more.

sentences.zh: 乃召端王入，即皇帝位，皇太后權同處分軍國事。

translations.literal: Prince Duan was summoned in and immediately took the imperial seat; the Empress Dowager exercised joint disposal of military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Duan was called in and took the throne; Empress Dowager Xiang held regency over army and state.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，赦天下常赦所不原者，百官進秩一等，賞諸軍。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: amnesty for all not normally pardoned in routine amnesties; officials advanced one grade; armies rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the court pardoned what routine amnesties left out, raised every office one grade, and paid the armies.

sentences.zh: 遣宋淵告哀於遼。

translations.literal: Song Yuan was sent to announce the mourning to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yuan was sent to bear word of mourning to Liao.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，尊先帝后為元符皇后。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the late emperor's empress was honored as Empress Yuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zhezong's empress was titled Empress Yuanfu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，追尊母貴儀陳氏為皇太妃。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the mother, Honored Consort Chen, was posthumously honored as Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Huizong's mother Chen was raised posthumously to Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命章惇為山陵使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhang Dun was appointed mausoleum commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhang Dun was made mausoleum commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，出先帝遺留物賜近臣。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the late emperor's bequeathed goods were distributed to close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhezong's bequests went to his closest ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以申王佖為太傅，進封陳王，賜贊拜不名。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Prince Shen Bian was made Grand Tutor, advanced to Prince of Chen, and granted the privilege of bowing without having his name spoken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Prince Shen Bian became Grand Tutor and Prince of Chen, with praise and bow without naming.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，進仁宗淑妃周氏、神宗淑妃邢氏並為貴妃，賢妃宋氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Lady Zhou of Manifest Favor and Lady Xing of Manifest Favor were both advanced to Noble Consort; Lady Song of Worthy Favor to Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Ladies Zhou and Xing of Manifest Favor became Noble Consorts; Lady Song of Worthy Favor became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以章惇為特進，封申國公。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhang Dun was made Special Advanced and enfeoffed Duke of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhang Dun was made Special Advanced and Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，進封莘王俁為衛王，守太保；

translations.literal: Day jichou: Prince Xin You was advanced to Prince of Wei, holding Junior Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Prince Xin You was raised to Prince of Wei as Junior Tutor;

sentences.zh: 簡王似為蔡王，睦王偲為定王，並守司徒。

translations.literal: Prince Jian Si to Prince of Cai, Prince Mu Xin to Prince of Ding, all holding Junior Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jian Si to Prince of Cai and Prince Mu Xin to Prince of Ding, each as Junior Secretary.

sentences.zh: 罷增八廂邏卒。

translations.literal: The added eight shifts of patrol soldiers were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The eight added patrol shifts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，始聽政。

translations.literal: Second month, day jihai: the emperor began to hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jihai: Huizong began to hear government.

sentences.zh: 尊先帝妃朱氏為聖瑞皇太妃。

translations.literal: The late emperor's consort Lady Zhu was honored as Sacred Felicity Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Zhezong's consort Lady Zhu was titled Sacred Felicity Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以南平王李乾德為檢校太師。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Southern Pacification King Li Qiande was made Inspector Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Southern Pacification King Li Qiande was made Inspector Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立順國夫人王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Lady Wang of Shun State was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lady Wang of Shun State was made empress.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，向宗回、宗良遷節度使，太后弟侄未仕者俱授以官。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Xiang Zonghui and Zongliang were transferred to military commissioners; the Empress Dowager's brothers' sons not yet in office were all given posts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Xiang Zonghui and Zongliang became military commissioners; every nephew of the Xiang clan still without office received one.

sentences.zh: 癸示，初禦紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day guisi: first audience at the Hall of Purple Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the throne first sat the Hall of Purple Brightness.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以吏部尚書韓忠彥為門下侍郎，資政殿大學士黃履為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Minister of Personnel Han Zhongyan was made Gate Vice Director; University Fellow Huang Lü was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Han Zhongyan became Gate Vice Director and Huang Lü Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，名懿親宅潛邸曰龍德宮。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the princely residence where the emperor had lived in seclusion was named Palace of Dragon Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Huizong's former princely house was named Dragon Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，毀承極殿。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Hall of Receiving the Pole was demolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Hall of Receiving the Pole was torn down.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣吳安憲、朱孝孫以遺留物遺遼國主。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Wu Anxian and Zhu Xiaosun were sent to present bequeathed goods to the Liao sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wu Anxian and Zhu Xiaosun carried bequests to the Liao ruler.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，詔宰臣、執政、侍從官各舉可任台諫者。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen new moon: an edict ordered grand councillors, administrators, and attendant officials each to recommend persons fit for censorate and remonstrance posts.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuchen new moon: grand councillors, administrators, and attendants were each to name men fit for the censorate and remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣韓治、曹譜告即位於遼。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Han Zhi and Cao Pu were sent to announce the accession to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Han Zhi and Cao Pu announced the accession to Liao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔追封祖宗諸子光濟等三十三人為王，女四十八人為公主。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict ordered posthumous enfeoffment as princes for thirty-three persons including Guangji among the ancestors' sons, and as princesses for forty-eight daughters.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, thirty-three ancestral princes including Guangji were posthumously enfeoffed, and forty-eight daughters as princesses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以西蕃王隴拶為河西軍節度使，尋賜姓名曰趙懷德，邈川首領瞎征為懷遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Western Fan king Longzan was made military commissioner of Hexi Army; shortly he was granted the surname Zhao and the name Huaide; the Miaochuan leader Xiazheng was made military commissioner of Huaiyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Western Fan king Longzan became Hexi military commissioner, soon surnamed Zhao and named Huaide; Miaochuan chief Xiazheng took Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以日當食，降德音於四京：減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: because the sun would suffer eclipse, a merciful edict in the four capitals: prisoners' crimes reduced one grade; those below exile released.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, with an eclipse due, the four capitals won mercy: one grade off every sentence, and freedom below exile.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，錄趙普後。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: descendants of Zhao Pu were recorded for favor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhao Pu's line was entered for favor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: an edict sought blunt memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the court called for blunt speech.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以寧遠軍節度觀察留後世雄為崇信軍節度使，封安定郡王。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Shixiong, military commissioner and observation regent of Ningyuan Army, was made military commissioner of Chongxin Army and enfeoffed Duke of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Shixiong of Ningyuan became Chongxin military commissioner and Duke of Anding.

sentences.zh: 乙未，卻永興民王懷所進玉器。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: jade vessels presented by the Yongxing commoner Wang Huai were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, jade offered by Wang Huai of Yongxing was refused.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, dingyou new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，令監司分部決獄。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict ordered supervisory commissioners to divide and decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, circuit supervisors were to divide and settle cases.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以韓忠彥為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，禮部尚書李清臣為門下侍郎，翰林學士蔣之奇同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Han Zhongyan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; Minister of Rites Li Qingchen was made Gate Vice Director; Hanlin Academician Jiang Zhiqi was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Han Zhongyan became Right Vice Director of State Affairs and Chancellery; Li Qingchen took the Gate; Jiang Zhiqi joined the Military Affairs bureau.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，錄曹佾後。

translations.literal: Day yisi: descendants of Cao Yi were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Cao Yi's line was entered for favor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以帝生日為天寧節。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the emperor's birthday was made the Heaven's Blessing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Huizong's birthday became the Heaven's Blessing Festival.

sentences.zh: 己酉，長子亶生。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the eldest son Dan was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the eldest son Dan was born.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大赦天下，應元符二年已前系官逋負悉蠲之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: great amnesty; all official arrears owed since Yuanfu 2 and before were fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a great amnesty wiped every official debt back through Yuanfu 2.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，鹿敏求等以應詔上書遷秩。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Lu Minqiu and others who had submitted memorials in response to the edict were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Lu Minqiu and others who answered the call for memorials were promoted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，請大行皇帝諡于南郊。

translations.literal: Day yimao: posthumous title for the late emperor was requested at the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zhezong's posthumous title was sought at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔範純仁等復官、宮觀，蘇軾等徙內郡居住。

translations.literal: Day dingji: an edict restored office and palace appointments to Fan Zhiren and others; Su Shi and others were moved to reside in inner prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji, Fan Zhiren and others regained office and palace posts; Su Shi and his circle were moved to inner prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷編類臣僚章疏局。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the bureau for compiling classified memorials of officials was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the bureau that sorted officials' memorials was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身五百十八人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: five hundred eighteen jinshi and other degree holders from the Ministry of Rites examination were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, five hundred eighteen men took jinshi and other degrees from the Ministry of Rites list.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔，罷理官失出之罰。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao new moon: the penalty for imperial clerks who lost documents on release was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingmao new moon: the penalty for clerks who lost papers on release was ended.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔復廢后孟氏為元祐皇后。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict restored the deposed empress Lady Meng as Empress Yuanyou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the deposed Lady Meng was restored as Empress Yuanyou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蔡卞罷。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Cai Bian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Cai Bian left office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔追復文彥博、王珪、司馬光、呂公著、呂大防、劉摯等三十三人官。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict posthumously restored office to thirty-three persons including Wen Yanbo, Wang Gui, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Lü Dafang, and Liu Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, thirty-three men including Wen Yanbo, Wang Gui, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Lü Dafang, and Liu Zhi were posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，還司馬光等致仕遺表恩。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: posthumous memorial favors for Sima Guang and others in retirement were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the court returned posthumous favors owed Sima Guang and other retired ministers.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，河北、河東、陝西饑，詔帥臣計度振恤。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi were in famine; an edict ordered frontier commissioners to plan relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, famine gripped Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi; frontier commissioners were to plan relief.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申朔，遼主遣蕭進忠、蕭安世等來弔祭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen new moon: the Liao sovereign sent Xiao Jinzhong, Xiao Anshi, and others to offer condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingshen new moon: Liao sent Xiao Jinzhong, Xiao Anshi, and others to mourn Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，奉皇太后詔，罷同聽政。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingyin new moon: following the Empress Dowager's edict, joint audience was ended.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingyin new moon: by Empress Dowager Xiang's edict, joint audience ended.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，告哲宗欽文睿武昭孝皇帝諡于天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhezong's posthumous title Emperor of Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, and Bright Filiality was announced to Heaven, Earth, the Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhezong was titled Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, Bright Filial and proclaimed to Heaven, Earth, temple, and altar.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上寶冊于福寧殿。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: treasure seals were presented at the Hall of Blessing and Tranquillity.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the treasure seals were offered at Blessing and Tranquillity Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以皇太后還政，減天下囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: because the Empress Dowager returned government, crimes throughout the empire were reduced one grade; those below exile released.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, as Xiang returned the regency, the empire won one grade of mercy and freedom below exile.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣陸佃、李嗣徽報謝於遼。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Lu Dian and Li Sihui were sent to return thanks to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Lu Dian and Li Sihui carried thanks to Liao.

sentences.zh: 罷管勾陝西、京、川路坑冶及江西、廣東、湖北、夔、梓、成都路管勾措置鹽事官。

translations.literal: Commissioners for Shaanxi, Jing, and Chuan circuit mining and smelting, and Jiangxi, Guangdong, Hubei, Kui, Zi, and Chengdu circuit salt administration commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Mining commissioners on Shaanxi, Jing, and Chuan circuits and salt commissioners on Jiangxi, Guangdong, Hubei, Kui, Zi, and Chengdu were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，封子亶為韓國公。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: son Dan was enfeoffed Duke of Han.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the son Dan was enfeoffed Duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，詔諸路遇民有疾，委官監醫往視疾給藥。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: an edict ordered that wherever the people had illness on the circuits, officials were delegated to supervise physicians to visit the sick and give medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuxu: wherever the people fell ill, circuit officials were to send physicians with medicine under supervision.

sentences.zh: 庚子，作景靈西宮，奉安神宗神禦，建哲宗神禦殿於其西。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Western Palace of Splendid Numen was built, enshrining Shenzong's spirit image; a hall for Zhezong's spirit image was built to its west.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Western Splendid Numen Palace rose for Shenzong's spirit; Zhezong's hall was built west of it.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，出內庫金帛二百萬糴陝西軍儲。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: two million strings of gold and silk from the inner treasury were released to purchase grain reserves in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, two million strings from the inner treasury bought grain for Shaanxi stores.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，葬哲宗皇帝于永泰陵。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Emperor Zhezong was buried at Yongtai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhezong was laid in Yongtai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣董敦逸賀遼主生辰，呂仲甫賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Dong Dunyi was sent to congratulate the Liao sovereign's birthday; Lü Zhongfu to congratulate New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Dong Dunyi congratulated the Liao ruler's birthday and Lü Zhongfu the New Year.

sentences.zh: 戊申，高麗王王熙遣使奉表來慰。

translations.literal: Day wushen: King Xi of Goryeo Wang Xi sent envoys with a memorial of consolation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Goryeo's King Xi sent envoys with words of comfort.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔以仁宗、神宗廟永世不祧。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict made the temples of Renzong and Shenzong never to be removed in the succession.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Renzong's and Shenzong's temples were fixed never to be displaced.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以蔡王似為太保。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince Cai Si was made Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince Cai Si became Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祔哲宗神主於太廟，廟樂曰《大成之舞》。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Zhezong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple; temple music was called "Dance of Great Completion."
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhezong's tablet entered the Ancestral Temple to the "Dance of Great Completion."

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yiwei: Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiwei: Western Xia brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，蔡京出知永興軍，貶章惇為武昌軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Cai Jing left for Yongxing Army; Zhang Dun was demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of Wuchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Cai Jing was sent to Yongxing and Zhang Dun demoted to Wuchang vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以韓忠彥為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Han Zhongyan was made Left Vice Director of State Affairs and concurrent Gate Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Han Zhongyan became Left Vice Director of State Affairs and Gate Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以曾布為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zeng Bu was made Right Vice Director of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zeng Bu became Right Vice Director of State Affairs and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，升端州為興慶軍。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Duanzhou was elevated to Xingqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Duanzhou was raised to Xingqing Army.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔禁曲學偏見、妄意改作以害國事者。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict forbade distorted learning, biased views, and reckless reforms that harm state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the court forbade crooked scholarship, partisan bias, and rash changes that injured the state.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷平准務。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Bureau of Price Stabilization was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Bureau of Price Stabilization was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，詔修《六朝寶訓》。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: an edict ordered compilation of Precious Admonitions of the Six Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao: the court ordered the Six Dynasties Precious Admonitions compiled.

sentences.zh: 降德音於端州：減囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: A merciful edict in Duan prefecture: crimes reduced one grade; penal servitude and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Duanzhou won mercy: one grade off sentences, freedom for penal servitude and below.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔改明年元。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict changed the next year's era name.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the court changed the era name for the coming year—Jianzhong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以觀文殿學士安燾知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture An Dian was made Vice Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, An Dian of the Observing Culture hall became Vice Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，黃履罷。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Huang Lü was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Huang Lü left office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，置《春秋》博士。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Doctor of the Spring and Autumn Annals was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, a Doctor of the Spring and Autumn was established.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，令陝西兼行銅、鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Shaanxi was ordered to circulate copper and iron coins jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Shaanxi was told to use copper and iron coin together.

sentences.zh: 以禮部尚書范純禮為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Fan Chunli was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chunli, Minister of Rites, became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，以皇太后不豫，禱于宮觀、祠廟、嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: because the Empress Dowager was unwell, prayers at palace abbeys, shrines, and mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiawu: with Empress Dowager Xiang ill, the court prayed at abbeys, shrines, and sacred peaks.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，出廩粟減價以濟民。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: granary grain released at reduced price to aid the people.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, state grain was sold cheap to feed the people.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: prisoners reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔修《國朝會要》。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an edict ordered compilation of Institutions of the Dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the court ordered the Institutions of the Dynasty compiled.

sentences.zh: 戊申，降德音于諸路：減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: a merciful edict on all circuits: crimes reduced one grade; those below exile released.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, every circuit won mercy: one grade off, freedom below exile.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遼人來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Liao envoys came to congratulate New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liao envoys came for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，出宮女六十九人。

translations.literal: That year, sixty-nine palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: That year, sixty-nine palace women were sent out.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，雨雹。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingshen: hail fell.

sentences.zh: 己亥，汰秦鳳路土兵。

translations.literal: Day jihai: native soldiers on the Qin-Feng circuit were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, native troops on the Qin-Feng circuit were cut.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，始聽政。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he began to hold court in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the emperor took up personal rule.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，出內庫及諸路常平錢各百萬，備河北邊儲。

translations.literal: Day yisi: one million cash each from the inner treasury and from every circuit’s ever-normal granary fund was released to stock the Hebei frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, a million cash each from the inner treasury and every circuit ever-normal fund went to Hebei frontier stores.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，貶章惇為雷州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Zhang Dun was demoted to revenue aide of Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Zhang Dun was demoted to Leizhou revenue aide.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，始禦紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: he first held court in Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiazi: he first held court in Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遼使蕭恭來告其主洪基殂，遣謝瓘、上官均等往弔祭，黃寔賀其孫延禧立。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Liao envoy Xiao Gong came to announce the death of his ruler Hongji; Xie Jin, Shangguan Jun, and others were sent to mourn, and Huang Shi was sent to congratulate his grandson Yanxi on his accession.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liao envoy Xiao Gong announced Hongji’s death; Xie Jin and Shangguan Jun went to mourn while Huang Shi congratulated Yanxi’s accession.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔以河西軍節度使趙懷德知湟州。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict made Military Commissioner of Hexi Army Zhao Huai’de prefect of Huang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhao Huai’de of Hexi Army was made Huang prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以日當食，避殿減膳，降天下囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: because an eclipse was due, he left the hall, reduced his meals, reduced crimes empire-wide one grade, and released those at exile or below.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, with an eclipse due, he left court, cut his meals, lowered crimes one grade empire-wide, and freed those at exile or below.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯朔，日食不見。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao new moon: an eclipse occurred but was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinmao new moon: an eclipse occurred but was not seen.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上大行皇太后諡曰欽聖憲肅。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the late Grand Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Qinsheng Xiansu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the late Grand Empress Dowager received the posthumous title Qinsheng Xiansu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上追尊皇太后諡曰欽慈。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Empress Dowager was given the augmented posthumous title Qinci.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Empress Dowager was raised to the posthumous title Qinci.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禦殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: he resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, court meals were resumed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諸路疑獄當奏而不奏者科罪，不當奏而輒奏者勿坐，著為令。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict ordered that in doubtful cases on the circuits, those who should memorialize but do not are to be punished, while those who should not memorialize but do are not to be prosecuted; this was written into statute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, circuit officials who failed to report doubtful cases were made punishable, while needless reports were exempted—written into law.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉朔，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou new moon: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou new moon: heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 詔三省減吏員、節冗費。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Three Departments to cut staff and curtail waste.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments were told to cut staff and waste.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，葬欽聖憲肅皇后、欽慈皇后于永裕陵。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Empresses Qinsheng Xiansu and Qinci were buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Empresses Qinsheng Xiansu and Qinci were buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蘇頌薨。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Su Song died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Su Song died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祔欽聖憲肅皇后、欽慈皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the spirit tablets of Empresses Qinsheng Xiansu and Qinci were enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the spirit tablets of Empresses Qinsheng Xiansu and Qinci entered the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，減兩京、河陽、鄭州囚罪一等，民緣山陵役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: crimes were reduced one grade in the two capitals, Heyang, and Zheng prefecture; commoners serving on mausoleum labor had their levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the two capitals, Heyang, and Zhengzhou cut crimes one grade and remitted levies on mausoleum laborers.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅朔，以韓國公亶為開府儀同三司，封京兆郡王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin new moon: Duke of Han Chan was made Honorary Grand Councilor of State and enfeoffed Prince of Jingzhao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengyin new moon: Duke of Han Chan became honorary grand councilor and Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 戊申，封向宗回為永陽郡王，向宗良為永嘉郡王。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Xiang Zonghui was enfeoffed Prince of Yongyang commandery and Xiang Zongliang Prince of Yongjia commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xiang Zonghui became Prince of Yongyang and Xiang Zongliang Prince of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，封吳王顥子孝騫為廣陵郡王，頵子孝參為信都郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wu Prince Hao’s son Xiaojian was enfeoffed Prince of Guangling commandery, and Yun’s son Xiaocan Prince of Xindu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Prince Hao’s son Xiaojian became Prince of Guangling and Yun’s son Xiaocan Prince of Xindu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，範純禮罷。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Fan Chunli was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Fan Chunli left office.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔班《鬥殺情理輕重格》。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict promulgated the Statute on Homicide by Affray with Graded Circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Statute on Homicide by Affray with Graded Circumstances was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，內郡置添差宗室闕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: supplementary imperial-clan posts were established in inner circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinsi: inner circuits gained supplementary imperial-clan posts.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，安燾罷。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: An Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, An Yan left office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以蔣之奇知樞密院事，吏部尚書陸佃為尚書右丞，端明殿學士章楶同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Jiang Zhiqi was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Minister of Personnel Lu Dian was made Right Vice Director of the Ministries; Academician of the Hall for Bright Clarity Zhang Shu was made Co-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Jiang Zhiqi directed Military Affairs; Lu Dian became right vice premier; Zhang Shu joined Military Affairs as co-director.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，詔諸路轉運、提舉司及諸州軍，有遺利可以講求及冗員浮費當裁損者，詳議以聞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: an edict ordered transport and fiscal-intendant offices and every prefecture and army that had untapped revenue to investigate, and redundant staff and waste to cut, to report in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jisi: circuits and prefectures were told to seek untapped revenue and cut redundant staff and waste, then report.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，子礻聖薨。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Prince Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Prince Fu died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，李清臣罷。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiwei: Li Qingchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiwei: Li Qingchen left office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，天寧節，群臣及遼使初上壽於垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: on the Tianning festival, ministers and the Liao envoy first offered birthday felicitations in Chuigong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Heaven’s Blessing Festival brought the first birthday felicitations from ministers and the Liao envoy in Chuigong Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，以陸佃為尚書左丞，吏部尚書溫益為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengshen: Lu Dian was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Minister of Personnel Wen Yi was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengshen: Lu Dian became left vice premier and Wen Yi right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以西蕃賒羅撒為西平軍節度使、邈川首領。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the western Tibetan Sherosak was made Military Commissioner of Xiping Army and chief of Miaochuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Sherosak became Xiping military commissioner and Miaochuan chief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，出禦制南郊親祀樂章。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the emperor’s southern-suburb personal-sacrifice hymn texts were issued.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the emperor issued his southern-suburb sacrifice hymns.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: offering was presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, offerings were made at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Ancestral Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the court feasted at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，祀天地於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Altar, and the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Altar and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 改彰信軍為興仁軍，昭德軍為隆德軍。

translations.literal: Zhangxin Army was renamed Xingren Army, and Zhaode Army was renamed Longde Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangxin Army became Xingren Army and Zhaode Army became Longde Army.

sentences.zh: 改明年元。

translations.literal: The next year’s reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: The next year’s reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，賜陳王佖詔書不名。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: Prince Bian of Chen was granted edicts that did not name him.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen: Prince Bian of Chen was granted the privilege of unnamed address in edicts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，進神宗昭儀武氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Lady Wu, Shenzong’s Bright Hall consort, was advanced to Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Shenzong’s consort Lady Wu was raised to Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 丙午，奉安神宗神禦于景靈西宮大明殿。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Shenzong’s imperial spirit portrait was enshrined in Daming Hall of Jingling Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Shenzong’s spirit portrait was enshrined in Daming Hall of Jingling Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詣宮行禮。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he went to the palace and performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he went to the palace for the rite.

sentences.zh: 己酉，降德音於四京，減囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a grace edict was issued in the four capitals; crimes were reduced one grade, and those at penal servitude or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a grace edict in the four capitals cut crimes one grade and freed those at penal servitude or below.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遼人來獻遺留物。

translations.literal: That year the Liao people presented leftover goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liao presented leftover goods.

sentences.zh: 河東地震，京畿蝗，江、淮、兩浙、湖南、福建旱。

translations.literal: Hedong had an earthquake; the capital region had locusts; the Yangzi, Huai, two Zhe circuits, Hunan, and Fujian had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong shook; the capital region had locusts; the Yangzi, Huai, two Zhes, Hunan, and Fujian suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 崇甯元年春正月丁丑，太原等十一郡地震，詔死者家賜錢有差。

translations.literal: Chongning, first year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Taiyuan and ten other prefectures had earthquakes; an edict ordered graded cash grants to families of the dead.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 1, spring, dingchou: Taiyuan and ten prefectures shook; families of the dead received graded cash grants.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，奉安哲宗神禦于景靈西宮寶慶殿。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: Zhezong’s imperial spirit portrait was enshrined in Baoqing Hall of Jingling Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi: Zhezong’s spirit portrait was enshrined in Baoqing Hall of Jingling Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詣宮行禮。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: he went to the palace and performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he went to the palace for the rite.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以定王偲為太保。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Prince Si of Ding was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Prince Si of Ding was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸定王第。

translations.literal: Day renshen: he visited Prince Si’s mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, he visited Prince Si’s mansion.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，上皇太后諡曰欽成。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: the Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Qincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jihai: the Empress Dowager received the posthumous title Qincheng.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，熒惑入鬥。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: Mars entered the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi: Mars entered the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚申，韓忠彥罷。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Han Zhongyan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Han Zhongyan left office.

sentences.zh: 己巳，瞎征卒。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Xiazheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Xiazheng died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，降復太子太保司馬光為正議大夫，太師文彥博為太子太保，餘各以差奪官。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: restored Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Sima Guang was reduced to Right Policy Grandee; Grand Preceptor Wen Yanbo was reduced to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; the rest had offices reduced by graded degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, restored Sima Guang was cut to Right Policy Grandee and Wen Yanbo to heir-apparent grand preceptor; the rest lost rank in graded steps.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔待制以上舉能吏各二人。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict ordered every official from Attendant-in-Ordinary upward to recommend two capable administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, every official from Attendant-in-Ordinary up was told to name two capable administrators.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，黜後苑內侍請以箔金飾宮殿者。

translations.literal: Day yihai: an inner-palace eunuch of the rear garden who had asked to ornament palace halls with gold foil was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, a rear-garden eunuch who sought gold-foil palace decoration was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔元祐諸臣各已削秩，自今無所復問，言者亦勿輒言。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict said Yuanyou officials had already had rank reduced; from now there would be no further inquiry, and memorializers were not to raise the matter again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yuanyou officials already demoted were declared closed to further inquiry or memorializing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，葬欽成皇后于永裕陵。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Empress Qincheng was buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Empress Qincheng was buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陸佃罷。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Lu Dian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Lu Dian left office.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以許將為門下侍郎，溫益為中書侍郎，翰林學士承旨蔡京為尚書左丞，吏部尚書趙挺之為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Xu Jiang was made Gate Vice Director; Wen Yi was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Cai Jing was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Minister of Personnel Zhao Tingzhi was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Xu Jiang took the Gate, Wen Yi the Chancellery, Cai Jing the left vice premiership, and Zhao Tingzhi the right.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，祔欽成皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: the spirit tablet of Empress Qincheng was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jichou: Empress Qincheng’s spirit tablet entered the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，減西京、河陽、鄭州囚罪一等，民緣山陵役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day renchen: crimes were reduced one grade in the Western Capital, Heyang, and Zheng prefecture; commoners serving on mausoleum labor had their levies remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Western Capital, Heyang, and Zhengzhou cut crimes one grade and remitted levies on mausoleum laborers.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔六曹尚書有事奏陳，許獨員上殿。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict allowed the six ministry directors, when they had business to memorialize, to ascend alone.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the six ministry directors were allowed solo audience when memorializing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改渝州為恭州。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Yu prefecture was renamed Gong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yu prefecture became Gong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔仿《唐六典》修神宗所定官制。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict ordered the official system fixed by Shenzong to be revised following the Tang Six Offices Canon.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Shenzong’s official system was ordered revised on the model of the Tang Six Offices Canon.

sentences.zh: 封伯夷為清惠侯，叔齊為仁惠侯。

translations.literal: Bo Yi was enfeoffed Marquis of Pure Grace, and Shu Qi Marquis of Humane Grace.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi was enfeoffed Marquis of Pure Grace and Shu Qi Marquis of Humane Grace.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅朔，更名哲宗神禦殿曰重光。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiayin new moon: Zhezong’s spirit-portrait hall was renamed Chongguang.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary jiayin new moon: Zhezong’s spirit-portrait hall was renamed Chongguang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，曾布罷。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zeng Bu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zeng Bu left office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔諸路州縣官有治績最著者，許監司、帥臣各舉一人。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict allowed each circuit intendant and military commissioner to recommend one prefectural or county official of the most outstanding governance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, each intendant and commissioner could name one prefectural or county official of outstanding governance.

sentences.zh: 壬午，追貶李清臣為武安軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Li Qingchen was posthumously demoted to military vice commissioner of Wu’an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Li Qingchen was posthumously demoted to Wu’an Army vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔監司、帥臣于本路小使臣以上及親民官內，有智謀勇果可備將帥者，各舉一人。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict allowed circuit intendants and military commissioners each to recommend one man from junior commissioners upward and from posts governing the people who had wisdom, counsel, courage, and resolution fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, intendants and commissioners could each name one junior commissioner or local official fit for command.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申朔，建長生宮以祠熒惑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiashen new moon: Longevity Palace was built to sacrifice to Mars.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiashen new moon: Longevity Palace was built for Mars worship.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔省、台、寺、監及監司、郡守，並以三年成任。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: an edict fixed three-year terms for provincial, censorate, temple, and commission offices and for circuit intendants and prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, provincial, censorate, temple, commission, intendant, and prefect posts were fixed at three-year terms.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以蔡京為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Cai Jing was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Cai Jing became Right Vice Director of State Affairs and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 己丑，焚元祐法。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Yuanyou laws were burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Yuanyou laws were burned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔於都省置講議司。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict established a Discussion Office at the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, a Discussion Office was set up at the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔杭州、明州置市舶司。

translations.literal: An edict ordered maritime trade offices established at Hangzhou and Ming prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Maritime trade offices were set up at Hangzhou and Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，章楶罷。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhang Shu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Shu left office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以雨水壞民廬舍，詔開封府振恤壓溺者。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: because rain had damaged people’s houses, an edict ordered Kaifeng prefecture to relieve those crushed or drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Kaifeng was told to aid those crushed or drowned when rain wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，罷《春秋》博士。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Spring and Autumn doctorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Spring and Autumn doctorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，子烜改名桓，煥改名楷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: Prince Xuan was renamed Huan, and Prince Huan was renamed Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yimao: Prince Xuan was renamed Huan and Prince Huan was renamed Kai.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷權侍郎官。

translations.literal: Day yichou: acting vice-minister posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, acting vice-minister posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置安濟坊，養民之貧病者，仍令諸郡縣並置。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Relief Halls were established to care for the poor and sick among the people, and every prefecture and county was likewise ordered to establish them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Relief Halls were set up for the poor and sick, and every prefecture and county was told to do the same.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔天下興學貢士，建外學于國南。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: an edict ordered schools empire-wide to advance tribute scholars, and an outer academy was built south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, empire-wide schools were ordered to advance scholars, and an outer academy was built south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔司馬光等二十一人子弟毋得官京師。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict forbade the sons and younger brothers of Sima Guang and twenty others from holding office in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, sons and younger brothers of Sima Guang and twenty others were barred from capital office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以趙挺之為尚書左丞，翰林學士張商英為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Zhao Tingzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Hanlin Academician Zhang Shangying was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhao Tingzhi became left vice premier and Zhang Shangying right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，京師置居養院，以處鰥寡孤獨，仍以戶絕財產給養。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: the capital established a Dwelling-and-Supporting Hall to house widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, using property from households without heirs to support them.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuzi: the capital opened a Dwelling-and-Supporting Hall for widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, funded from heirless estates.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔中書籍元符三年臣僚章疏姓名為正上、正中、正下三等，邪上、邪中、邪下三等。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered the Secretariat to register Yuanfu 3 officials’ memorial names as orthodox upper, middle, and lower and heterodox upper, middle, and lower.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yuanfu 3 memorialists were registered in orthodox and heterodox upper, middle, and lower grades.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，治臣僚議復元祐皇后及謀廢元符皇后者罪，降韓忠彥、曾布官，追貶李清臣為雷州司戶參軍，黃履為祁州團練副使，竄曾肇以下十七人。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: officials who had urged restoring the Yuanyou empress and those who had plotted to depose the Yuanfu empress were punished; Han Zhongyan and Zeng Bu were demoted in rank; Li Qingchen was posthumously demoted to Leizhou revenue aide; Huang Lü was demoted to military vice commissioner of Qi prefecture; Zeng Zhao and seventeen others below him were banished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, officials who had urged restoring the Yuanyou empress or deposing the Yuanfu empress were punished—Han Zhongyan and Zeng Bu demoted, Li Qingchen posthumously sent to Leizhou, Huang Lü to Qi vice commissioner, and Zeng Zhao with seventeen others banished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，籍元祐及元符末宰相文彥博等、侍從蘇軾等、余官秦觀等、內臣張士良等、武臣王獻可等凡百有二十人，禦書刻石端禮門。

translations.literal: Day jihai: grand councilors of the Yuanyou and late Yuanfu eras such as Wen Yanbo, attendants such as Su Shi, other officials such as Qin Guan, inner attendants such as Zhang Shiliang, and military officers such as Wang Xiank—one hundred twenty persons in all—were registered; imperial calligraphy was carved on stone at Duanli Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, one hundred twenty Yuanyou and late-Yuanfu figures—from Wen Yanbo and Su Shi to Qin Guan, Zhang Shiliang, and Wang Xiank—were blacklisted and inscribed in the emperor’s hand at Duanli Gate.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以元符末上書人鐘世美以下四十一人為正等，悉加旌擢；

translations.literal: Day gengzi: forty-one Yuanfu memorialists from Zhong Shimei downward were classed orthodox and all were promoted and honored;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, forty-one Yuanfu memorialists from Zhong Shimei down were classed orthodox and promoted;

sentences.zh: 范柔中以下五百余人為邪等，降責有差。

translations.literal: more than five hundred persons from Fan Rouzhong downward were classed heterodox and demoted or reprimanded by graded degrees.
translations.idiomatic: and more than five hundred from Fan Rouzhong down were classed heterodox and punished in graded degrees.

sentences.zh: 時世美已卒，詔贈官，仍官其子一人。

translations.literal: As Shimei had already died, an edict granted him posthumous office and still gave one son an appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Shimei already dead, he was granted posthumous office and one son was appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貶曾布為武泰軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zeng Bu was demoted to military vice commissioner of Wutai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zeng Bu was demoted to Wutai Army vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「元符三年、建中靖國元年責降臣僚已經牽復者，其元責告命並繳納尚書省。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an edict said: “For officials demoted in Yuanfu 3 and Jianzhong Jingguo 1 who have already been reinstated, the original demotion patents must be surrendered to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an edict ordered officials reinstated after Yuanfu 3 and Jianzhong Jingguo 1 demotions to surrender their original demotion patents to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 」冬十月癸亥，蔣之奇罷。

translations.literal: ” Winter, tenth month, day guihai: Jiang Zhiqi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guihai: Jiang Zhiqi left office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔責降宮觀人不得同一州居住。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict forbade demoted officials on palace appointment from residing in the same prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, demoted officials on palace appointment were forbidden to live in the same prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以御史錢遹、石豫、左膚及輔臣蔡京、許將、溫益、趙挺之、張商英等言，罷元祐皇后之號，復居瑤華宮。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: on memorial by Censors Qian Yi, Shi Yu, and Zuo Fu and chief ministers Cai Jing, Xu Jiang, Wen Yi, Zhao Tingzhi, and Zhang Shangying, the Yuanyou Empress’s title was abolished and she was returned to Yaohua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, at the urging of Qian Yi, Shi Yu, Zuo Fu, Cai Jing, Xu Jiang, Wen Yi, Zhao Tingzhi, and Zhang Shangying, the Yuanyou Empress was stripped of her title and sent back to Yaohua Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，劉奉世等二十七人坐元符末黨與變法，並罷祠祿。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Liu Fengshi and twenty-six others, convicted at the end of Yuanfu of faction with the reform party, all lost their temple-salary posts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Liu Fengshi and twenty-six others lost temple salaries for Yuanfu-end ties to the reform faction.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以資政殿學士蔡卞知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Cai Bian was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Cai Bian became Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，邵州言知溪洞徽州楊光銜內附。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: Shaozhou reported that Yang Guangxian, administrator of Xizhou in the Xidong stream region, submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiyou: Shaozhou reported Xidong administrator Yang Guangxian of Xizhou had submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以婉儀鄭氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Graceful Consort Zheng was made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Graceful Consort Zheng was advanced to Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置河北安濟坊。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Relief Halls were established in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Hebei Relief Halls were established.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，置西、南兩京宗正司及敦宗院。

translations.literal: Day guisi: clan directorates for the western and southern capitals and the Hall for Honoring the Clan were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, clan directorates for both western and southern capitals and the Hall for Honoring the Clan were set up.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，置顯謨閣學士、待制官。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: posts of academician and attendant of the Hall for Illustrious Counsel were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Illustrious Counsel academicians and attendants were instituted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，子楷為開府儀同三司，封高密郡王。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Prince Kai was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and enfeoffed Prince of Gaomi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Prince Kai was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Prince of Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，立卿、監、郎官三歲黜陟法。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a triennial promotion-and-removal law for directors, supervisors, and bureau officials was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a three-year review law for directors, supervisors, and bureau officers was enacted.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，論棄湟州罪，貶韓忠彥為崇信軍節度副使，曾布為賀州別駕，安燾為甯國軍節度副使，範純禮分司南京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: the crime of abandoning Huangzhou was debated; Han Zhongyan was demoted to military deputy commissioner of Chongxin Army, Zeng Bu to registrar of Hezhou, An Tao to military deputy commissioner of Ningguo Army, and Fan Chunli was assigned to Nanjing as an outside commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guichou: abandoning Huangzhou was tried—Han Zhongyan to Chongxin deputy commissioner, Zeng Bu to Hezhou registrar, An Tao to Ningguo deputy commissioner, Fan Chunli to outside service at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，鑄當五錢。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: five-count cash was cast.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, five-count cash was cast.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，贈哲宗子鄧王茂為皇太子，諡獻湣。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the late Prince Mao of Deng, son of Zhezong, was posthumously made heir apparent with the posthumous name Dedicated and Lamented.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhezong’s son Prince Mao of Deng was posthumously made heir apparent as Dedicated and Lamented.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔：「諸邪說詖行非先聖賢之書，及元祐學術政事，並勿施用。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: “Heretical doctrines and wicked practices not found in the books of the former sages, and Yuanyou academic policies and governance, are all forbidden from use.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, an edict forbade heretical doctrines, wicked practices outside the sages’ books, and all Yuanyou academic policies and governance.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，京畿、京東、河北、淮南蝗。

translations.literal: ” That year, locusts struck the capital region, eastern Jing, Hebei, and Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts ravaged the capital region, eastern Jing, Hebei, and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 江、浙、熙河、漳、泉、潭、衡、郴州、興化軍旱。

translations.literal: Jiang, Zhe, Xihe, Zhang, Quan, Tan, Heng, and Chen prefectures and Xinghua Army suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Drought afflicted Jiang, Zhe, Xihe, Zhang, Quan, Tan, Heng, and Chen and Xinghua Army.

sentences.zh: 辰、沅州徭入寇。

translations.literal: The Yao of Chen and Yuan prefectures raided inward.
translations.idiomatic: Yao raiders from Chen and Yuan struck inward.

sentences.zh: 出宮女七十六人。

translations.literal: Seventy-six palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-six palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳朔。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day xinsi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 2, spring, first month, xinsi new moon.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，竄任伯雨、陳瓘、龔𡙇、鄒浩于嶺南，馬涓等九人分貶諸州。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Ren Boyu, Chen Guan, Gong Fu, and Zou Hao were banished to Lingnan; Ma Juan and eight others were scattered to various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Ren Boyu, Chen Guan, Gong Fu, and Zou Hao were sent to Lingnan; Ma Juan and eight others were scattered to distant prefectures.

sentences.zh: 知荊南舒亶平辰、沅州徭賊，復誠、徽州，改誠州為靖州，徽州為蒔竹縣。

translations.literal: Jingnan prefect Shu Dan pacified the Chen and Yuan Yao bandits, recovered Cheng and Huizhou, renamed Chengzhou Jingzhou and Huizhou Shizhu county.
translations.idiomatic: Jingnan prefect Shu Dan crushed the Chen–Yuan Yao, recovered Cheng and Hui, renamed Cheng Jingzhou and Hui Shizhu county.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，溫益卒。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wen Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wen Yi died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以復荊湖疆土，曲赦兩路。

translations.literal: Day yisi: because Jing–Hu lands were recovered, a partial amnesty was granted on both circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, both Jing–Hu circuits received a partial amnesty for the recovered territory.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以沍寒，令監司分部決獄。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: because of severe cold, circuit commissioners were ordered to review prisoners by district.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, circuit commissioners were told to review prisoners in the cold.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以蔡京為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Cai Jing was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cai Jing became Left Vice Director of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，安化蠻入寇，廣西經略使程節敗之。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai: the Anhua Man raided; Guangxi pacification commissioner Cheng Jie defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinhai: Anhua Man raiders were beaten by Guangxi commissioner Cheng Jie.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣官相度湖南、北ＯＤ地，取其材植入供在京營造。

translations.literal: Day renzi: officials were sent to survey Hunan north and south for timber and plants to supply capital construction.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, officials were sent to survey Hunan north and south for timber and plants for capital works.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，進元符皇后為太后，宮名崇恩。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Yuanfu Empress was advanced to Empress Dowager; her palace name was Chongen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Yuanfu Empress became Empress Dowager Chongen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，置殿中監。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Palace Directorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Palace Directorate was established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，奉安哲宗御容於西京會聖宮及應天院。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Zhezong’s imperial portrait was installed at Huisheng Palace in the western capital and at Yingtian Cloister.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhezong’s portrait was installed at western-capital Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Cloister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，置諸路茶場。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: tea markets were established on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, tea markets were set up on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，進仁宗充儀張氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: Renzong’s Honored Consort Zhang was advanced to Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renwu: Renzong’s Honored Consort Zhang became Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，減西京囚罪一等。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: western-capital prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, western-capital sentences were reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 詔党人子弟毋得擅到闕下，其應緣趨附黨人、罷任在外、指射差遣及得罪停替臣僚亦如之。

translations.literal: Edict: children of faction members were not to come to court on their own; those who had curried favor with faction members, dismissed officials outside the capital who sought appointments by influence, and punished or suspended officials were likewise barred.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred faction members’ children from court, along with favor-seekers, dismissed outsiders angling for posts, and punished or suspended officials.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the emperor examined presented scholars at the Hall for Assembling the Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, presented scholars were examined at the Hall for Assembling the Worthy.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身五百三十八人，其嘗上書在正等者升甲，邪等者黜之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: five hundred thirty-eight metropolitan graduates of jinshi and “passed” rank were granted; those who had memorialized in the orthodox tiers were raised in examination rank, and those in heterodox tiers were removed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, 538 metropolitan graduates were named; orthodox memorialists rose in rank and heterodox ones were struck off.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，詔侍從官各舉所知二人。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin, edict: each attendant was to recommend two men he knew.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiayin: each attendant was told to name two men he knew.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，于闐入貢。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Yutian sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yutian sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔毀呂公著、司馬光、呂大防、範純仁、劉摯、範百祿、梁燾、王岩叟景靈西宮繪像。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, edict: the painted portraits of Lü Gongzhu, Sima Guang, Lü Dafang, Fan Chunren, Liu Zhi, Fan Baimian, Liang Tao, and Wang Yansou in the western hall of Jingling Palace were to be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, portraits of Lü Gongzhu, Sima Guang, Lü Dafang, Fan Chunren, Liu Zhi, Fan Baimian, Liang Tao, and Wang Yansou at Jingling’s western hall were ordered destroyed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以初謁景靈宮，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because of the first audience at Jingling Palace, the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the realm was amnestied for the first Jingling audience.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔毀刊行《唐鑒》並三蘇、秦、黃等文集。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: the printed Tang Mirror and collected works of the three Su, Qin, Huang, and others were to be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Tang Mirror and collected works of the three Su, Qin, Huang, and others were ordered destroyed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以趙挺之為中書侍郎，張商英為尚書左丞，戶部尚書吳居厚為尚書右丞，兵部尚書安惇同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Zhao Tingzhi was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Zhang Shangying Left Vice Director of State Affairs; Minister of Revenue Wu Juhou Right Vice Director; Minister of War An Dun Associate Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhao Tingzhi became Vice Director of the Secretariat, Zhang Shangying Left Vice Director, Wu Juhou Right Vice Director, and An Dun associate director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 奪王珪贈諡，追毀程頤出身文字，其所著書令監司覺察。

translations.literal: Wang Gui’s posthumous title was revoked; Cheng Yi’s examination credentials were hunted down and destroyed, and his books were placed under circuit surveillance.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui’s posthumous title was revoked, Cheng Yi’s credentials were hunted down and burned, and his books were put under circuit watch.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以賢妃鄭氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Worthy Consort Zheng was made Graceful Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinsi: Worthy Consort Zheng became Graceful Consort.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以陳王佖為太師。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Prince Chen Bian was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Prince Chen Bian was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，貶曾布為廉州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zeng Bu was demoted to registrar of Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zeng Bu was demoted to Lianzhou registrar.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封子楫為楚國公。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Prince Ji was enfeoffed Duke of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Prince Ji was enfeoffed Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，冊元符皇后劉氏為太后。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Yuanfu Empress Liu was installed as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yuanfu Empress Liu was installed as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，冊王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Lady Wang was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renzi: Lady Wang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔：「元符末上書進士，類多詆訕，令州郡遣入新學，依大學自訟齋法，候及一年，能革心自新者許將來應舉，其不變者當屏之遠方。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: “Metropolitan graduates who memorialized at the end of Yuanfu were mostly slanderous; let prefectures send them into the new schools and treat them by the university’s Repentance Lodge rule; after one year those who reform may be allowed to test again, and those who do not shall be banished far away.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, an edict ordered Yuanfu-end memorialist graduates—mostly slanderers—into new schools under the university Repentance Lodge rule; after a year the reformed might test again, the rest banished far off.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，慮囚。

translations.literal: ” Day renxu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 是月，中太一宮火。

translations.literal: That month the Central Temple of the Great One burned.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Central Temple of the Great One burned.

sentences.zh: 復湟州。

translations.literal: Huangzhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，學士院火。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jimao: the Hanlin Academy burned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jimao: the Hanlin Academy burned.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以復湟州，進蔡京官三等，蔡卞以下二等。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: because Huangzhou was recovered, Cai Jing was advanced three ranks and Cai Bian and those below two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Huangzhou’s recovery brought Cai Jing three ranks and Cai Bian and others two.

sentences.zh: 壬午，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day renwu: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲申，降德音于熙河蘭會路：減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: a grace edict was issued on the Xihe–Lan–Hui circuit: prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xihe–Lan–Hui received a grace edict cutting sentences one degree and freeing those below exile.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，曾肇責授濮州團練副使。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Zeng Zhao was demoted to military deputy commissioner of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zeng Zhao was demoted to Puzhou deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔上書進士見充三舍生者罷歸。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: metropolitan graduates now in the Three Colleges were dismissed to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, memorialist graduates still in the Three Colleges were sent home.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔自今戚裏宗屬勿復為執政官，著為令。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: from now imperial affines and imperial clan were not again to hold chief-councilor posts; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, imperial affines and clan were barred from chief-councilor posts by standing rule.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔責降人子弟毋得任在京及府界差遣。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: children of the demoted were not to hold appointments in the capital or the capital prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, children of the demoted were barred from posts in the capital and its prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未朔，再論棄湟州罪，貶韓忠彥為磁州團練副使，安燾為祁州團練副使，範純禮為靜江軍節度副使，削蔣之奇秩三等。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei new moon: the crime of abandoning Huangzhou was debated again; Han Zhongyan was demoted to military deputy commissioner of Cizhou, An Tao to military deputy commissioner of Qizhou, Fan Chunli to military deputy commissioner of Jingjiang Army, and Jiang Zhiqi’s rank was cut three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingwei new moon: abandoning Huangzhou was retried—Han Zhongyan to Cizhou, An Tao to Qizhou, Fan Chunli to Jingjiang, and Jiang Zhiqi lost three ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張商英罷。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhang Shangying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Shangying was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔張商英入元祐黨籍。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: Zhang Shangying was entered on the Yuanyou faction register.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Shangying was entered on the Yuanyou faction list.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，詔宗室不得與元祐奸黨子孫為婚姻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi, edict: imperial clan were not to marry descendants of Yuanyou traitors.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinsi: imperial clan were forbidden to marry Yuanyou-traitor descendants.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，封子樞為吳國公。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Prince Shu was enfeoffed Duke of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Prince Shu was enfeoffed Duke of Wu.

sentences.zh: 詔：「上書邪等人，知縣以上資序並與外祠，選人不得改官及為縣令。

translations.literal: Edict: “Heterodox memorialists of county magistrate rank and above were all given outside temple posts; selection candidates were not to change office or become county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: An edict gave heterodox memorialists of county rank and above outside temple posts and barred selection candidates from promotion or county magistracies.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，置醫學。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Medical School was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Medical School was established.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，令天下郡皆建崇寧寺。

translations.literal: Day guisi: every commandery was ordered to build a Chongning Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, every commandery was ordered to build a Chongning Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改吏部選人自承直郎至將仕郎七階。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Personnel Ministry’s seven selection ranks from Bearer of Uprightness to Candidate for Office were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Personnel Ministry’s seven ranks from Bearer of Uprightness to Candidate for Office were revised.

sentences.zh: 令天下監司長吏廳各立《元祐奸黨碑》。

translations.literal: Every circuit commissioner and prefect was ordered to erect a Yuanyou Traitor Stele in his main hall.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit commissioner and prefect was ordered to erect a Yuanyou Traitor Stele in his main hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔郡縣謹祀社稷。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: commanderies and counties were to sacrifice carefully to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, commanderies and counties were ordered to keep the soil-and-grain sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚辰，以元祐學術政事聚徒傳授者，委監司舉察，必罰無赦。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day gengchen: those who gathered disciples to teach Yuanyou academic policies and governance were to be reported by circuit commissioners and punished without mercy.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengchen: teaching Yuanyou learning or policy in groups was to be reported and punished without mercy.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，祧宣祖皇帝、昭憲皇后。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai: Emperor Xuanzu and Empress Zhaoxian were moved back in the temple line.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guihai: Emperor Xuanzu and Empress Zhaoxian were moved back in the temple line.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔六曹長貳歲考郎官治狀，分三等以聞。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: the six ministry vice ministers were annually to grade bureau officials’ records in three tiers and report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the six vice ministers were to grade bureau officials annually in three tiers and report.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路蝗。

translations.literal: That year, locusts struck all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts struck every circuit.

sentences.zh: 纂府蠻楊晟銅、融州楊晟天、邵州黃聰內附。

translations.literal: The Zuanfu Man Yang Shengtong of Zuan prefecture, Yang Shengtian of Rong prefecture, and Huang Cong of Shaozhou submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Zuanfu’s Yang Shengtong, Rong’s Yang Shengtian, and Shaozhou’s Huang Cong submitted.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己卯，安化蠻降。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day jimao: the Anhua Man surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 3, spring, jimao: the Anhua Man surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔上書邪等人毋得至京師。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: heterodox memorialists were not to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, heterodox memorialists were barred from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，鑄當十大錢。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: ten-count cash was cast.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, ten-count cash was cast.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，增縣學弟子員。

translations.literal: Day renchen: county-school student quotas were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, county-school quotas were raised.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜蔡京子攸進士出身。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Cai Jing’s son You was granted jinshi by birth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Cai Jing’s son You was granted jinshi by birth.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鑄九鼎。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Nine Cauldrons were cast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Nine Cauldrons were cast.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，以淑妃鄭氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingwu: Graceful Consort Zheng was made Precious Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingwu: Graceful Consort Zheng became Precious Consort.

sentences.zh: 以刊定元豐役法不當，黜錢遹以下九人。

translations.literal: Because the Yuanfeng corvée statutes had been wrongly revised, Qian Yi and eight others were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yi and eight others were dismissed for wrongly revising the Yuanfeng corvée statutes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，置漏澤園。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Louze Garden was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Louze Garden was established.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔王珪、章惇別為一籍，如元祐黨。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: Wang Gui and Zhang Dun were placed on a separate register, like the Yuanyou faction.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Gui and Zhang Dun were listed on a separate register like the Yuanyou faction.

sentences.zh: 詔自今禦後殿，許起居郎、舍人侍立。

translations.literal: Edict: from now when the emperor held court in the rear hall, attendance masters and remonstrance masters might stand in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict let attendance and remonstrance masters stand by when the emperor held court in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以楚國公楫為開府儀同三司，封南陽郡王。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Duke of Chu Ji was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and enfeoffed Prince of Nanyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Duke of Chu Ji was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Prince of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，令天下坑冶金銀復盡輸內藏。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: all mined gold and silver nationwide was again to be delivered in full to the Inner Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, all mined gold and silver was again to go in full to the Inner Treasury.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，置文繡院。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: the Brocade and Embroidery Court was established.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinsi: the Brocade and Embroidery Court was established.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，作圜土，以居強盜貸死者。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Round Prison was built to hold violent robbers reprieved from death.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Round Prison was built for violent robbers reprieved from death.

sentences.zh: 甲午，躋欽成皇后神主于欽慈皇后之上。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Empress Qincheng’s spirit tablet was placed above Empress Qinci’s.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Empress Qincheng’s tablet was set above Empress Qinci’s.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大內災。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: fire struck within the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, fire broke out in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，以火災降德音於四京：減囚罪一等，流以下原之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: because of the fire a grace edict was issued in the four capitals: prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree and those below exile were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yisi: the four capitals received a fire grace edict cutting sentences one degree and pardoning those below exile.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復鄯州，建為隴右都護府。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Zong prefecture was recovered and made Longyou Protectorate-General.
