translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zong was recovered and made Longyou Protectorate-General.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，徙封楫為樂安郡王。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Ji’s enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Le’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Ji was moved to the Le’an princedom.

sentences.zh: 復廓州。

translations.literal: Kuozhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Kuozhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷講議司。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Deliberation Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Deliberation Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，曲赦陝西。

translations.literal: Day jisi: a partial amnesty was granted in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Shaanxi received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬申，楫薨。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Ji died.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，罷開封權知府，置牧、尹、少尹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: the acting Kaifeng prefect was abolished; a governor, chief governor, and junior governors were established.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuyin: Kaifeng’s acting prefect was abolished and a governor, chief governor, and junior governors were set up.

sentences.zh: 改定六曹，以吏、戶、儀、兵、刑、工為序，增其員數，仿《唐六典》易胥吏之稱。

translations.literal: The six ministries were reordered as Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works, their staffs increased, and clerk titles were changed to follow the Tang Six Canons.
translations.idiomatic: The six ministries were reordered Personnel–Works, staffs enlarged, and clerk titles were brought in line with the Tang Six Canons.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以復鄯、廓，蔡京為守司空，封嘉國公。

translations.literal: Day jimao: because Zong and Kuo were recovered, Cai Jing was made Acting Minister of Works and enfeoffed Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zong and Kuo’s recovery made Cai Jing Acting Minister of Works and Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，許將、趙挺之、吳居厚、安惇、蔡卞各轉三官。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Xu Jiang, Zhao Tingzhi, Wu Juhou, An Dun, and Cai Bian were each advanced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Xu Jiang, Zhao Tingzhi, Wu Juhou, An Dun, and Cai Bian each gained three ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲申，改鄯州為西寧州，仍為隴右節度。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zong prefecture was renamed Xining prefecture and made Longyou military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zong became Xining prefecture with a Longyou military commission.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔黜守臣進金助修宮庭者。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: circuit commissioners who had offered gold to help build palaces were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, circuit commissioners who had offered gold for palace building were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔，圖熙甯、元豐功臣于顯謨閣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renyin new moon: Shenning and Yuanfeng merit officials were painted in the Hall for Illustrious Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renyin new moon: Shenning and Yuanfeng merit officials were painted in the Hall for Illustrious Counsel.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以王安石配饗孔子廟。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Wang Anshi was given a place in Confucius’s temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Anshi was enshrined in Confucius’s temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，增諸州學未立者。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: prefectural schools not yet established were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, prefectural schools still lacking were added.

sentences.zh: 壬子，置書、畫、算學。

translations.literal: Day renzi: schools of calligraphy, painting, and mathematics were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, calligraphy, painting, and mathematics schools were established.

sentences.zh: 占城入貢。

translations.literal: Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔重定元祐、元符黨人及上書邪等者合為一籍，通三百九人，刻石朝堂，餘並出籍，自今毋得復彈奏。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: the Yuanyou and Yuanfu faction registers and heterodox memorialists were combined into one list totaling three hundred nine persons, engraved on stone in the court hall; the rest were removed from the register, and from now none might again be impeached.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yuanyou, Yuanfu, and heterodox lists were merged into 309 names carved at court; the rest were cleared and might not be impeached again.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復置太醫局。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Imperial Medical Service was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Imperial Medical Service was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day guihai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔內外官毋得越職論事，僥倖奔競，違者御史台彈奏。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: inner and outer officials were not to discuss affairs outside their duties or scramble for favor; violators were to be impeached by the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, officials were barred from out-of-jurisdiction memorials and favor-scrambling on pain of censorial impeachment.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，以婉儀王氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou: Graceful Consort Wang was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiyou: Graceful Consort Wang became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔自今大禮不受尊號，群臣毋上表。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: from now great rites would not receive honorific titles, and ministers were not to submit congratulatory tables.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, great rites were denied honorific titles and ministers were forbidden congratulatory tables.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，行方田法。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Square Fields law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Square Fields law took effect.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，詔諸路知州、通判增入「主管學事」四字。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi, edict: circuit prefects and military vice commissioners were to add the four characters “in charge of school affairs.”
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengzi: circuit prefects and vice commissioners gained the title “in charge of school affairs.”

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大雨，壞民廬舍，令收瘞死者。

translations.literal: Day renyin: heavy rain destroyed people’s houses; the dead were to be collected and buried.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, heavy rain wrecked houses and the dead were ordered collected and buried.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，蔡京上《神宗史》。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Cai Jing submitted the Veritable Records of Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Cai Jing submitted Shenzong’s Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 丙午，許將罷。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Xu Jiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xu Jiang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，以趙挺之為門下侍郎，吳居厚為中書侍郎，翰林學士承旨張康國為尚書左丞，刑部尚書鄧洵武為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: Zhao Tingzhi was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Wu Juhou Vice Director of the Secretariat; Hanlin academician recipient Zhang Kangguo Left Vice Director of State Affairs; Minister of Justice Deng Xunwu Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yihai: Zhao Tingzhi became Vice Director of the Chancellery, Wu Juhou of the Secretariat, Zhang Kangguo Left Vice Director, and Deng Xunwu Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔諸路州學別置齋舍，以養材武之士。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: every circuit’s prefectural school was to set up separate lodges to nurture men of martial talent.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, every prefectural school was to add lodges for martial talent.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛居朔，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou new moon: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinyou new moon: heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賢妃張氏薨。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Worthy Consort Zhang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Worthy Consort Zhang died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命官編類六朝勳臣。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: officials were ordered to compile meritorious ministers of the Six Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, officials were ordered to compile Six Dynasties merit ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夏人入涇原，圍平夏城，寇鎮戎軍。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Xia forces entered Jingyuan, besieged Pingxia city, and raided Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Xia entered Jingyuan, besieged Pingxia, and raided Zhenrong Army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，熙河蘭會路經略安撫使王厚言，河西軍節度使趙懷德等出降。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Xihe–Lan–Hui pacification commissioner Wang Hou reported that Hexi military commissioner Zhao Huaide and others had come out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Hou reported Hexi commissioner Zhao Huaide and others had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立九廟，復翼祖、宣祖。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Nine Temples were established and Yizu and Xuanzu were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Nine Temples were set up and Yizu and Xuanzu were restored.

sentences.zh: 庚午，貴妃邢氏薨。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Precious Consort Xing died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Precious Consort Xing died.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，幸太學，官論定之士十六人，遂幸辟雍，賜國子司業吳絪、蔣靜四品服，學官推恩有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: the emperor visited the Imperial University; sixteen men who had passed the “determination” rite were there; he then visited the Imperial Academy, granting fourth-rank robes to National University vice chancellor Wu Yin and Jiang Jing and graded favors to the school officers.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu: he visited the Imperial University and sixteen “determined” scholars, then the Imperial Academy, granting fourth-rank robes to Wu Yin and Jiang Jing and graded favors to the staff.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，封子杞為冀國公。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Prince Qi was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Prince Qi was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔取士並繇學校，罷發解及省試法，科場如故事。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: recruitment was entirely through schools; the dispatch-examination and metropolitan-examination methods were abolished, and the examination field followed the old pattern.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, recruitment was routed entirely through schools; dispatch and metropolitan exams were ended while the field followed old forms.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，更上神宗諡曰體元顯道帝德王功英文烈武欽仁聖孝皇帝，加上哲宗諡曰憲元繼道顯德定功欽文睿武齊聖昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Shenzong’s posthumous title was augmented as Emperor of Constitutional Pattern, Manifest Way, Imperial Virtue, Royal Merit, Literary Elegance, Fierce Martiality, Reverent Benevolence, Sagely Filiality; Zhezong’s was augmented as Emperor of Statutory Pattern, Continuing the Way, Manifest Virtue, Settled Merit, Reverent Culture, Sagely Martiality, Equal Sagacity, and Proclaiming Filiality.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Shenzong’s and Zhezong’s posthumous titles were greatly lengthened with new honorific strings.

sentences.zh: 甲午，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: audience offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙未，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Ancestral Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Ancestral Temple received the feast offering.

sentences.zh: 丙申，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: August Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound and the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 升興仁、隆德軍為府，還彰信、昭德舊節。

translations.literal: Xingren and Longde Armies were advanced to prefectures and Zhangxin and Zhaode old military commissions were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Xingren and Longde armies became prefectures and the old Zhangxin and Zhaode commissions were restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，升通遠軍為鞏州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: Tongyuan Army was advanced to Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi: Tongyuan Army was advanced to Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜陳王佖入朝不趨。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince Chen Bian was granted not to hurry on entering court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince Chen Bian was excused from hurrying at court entry.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路蝗。

translations.literal: That year, locusts struck all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts struck every circuit.

sentences.zh: 出宮女六十二人。

translations.literal: Sixty-two palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty-two palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 廣西黎洞楊晟免等內附。

translations.literal: Guangxi’s Li cave Yang Shengmian and others submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi’s Li-cave Yang Shengmian and others submitted.
